test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct?

× and +

I. 4 × 3 + 6 - 7 ÷ 1 = 15

II. 7 + 5 × 2 - 8 ÷ 4 = 33
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/952c967501c582f1911db7fefdaaefa9b6e3f505512624eb925e04e002be5a1f.png] 

According to the question, after replacing the signs × and +:

I. 4 × 3 + 6 - 7 ÷ 1 = 15 ⇒ 4 + 3 × 6 - 7 ÷ 1 = 15

⇒ 4 + 3 × 6 - __**7 ÷ 1**__ = 15
